result.description:
Residential Framing Construction Manager - Larapinta, QLD (Full-Time)  
  Location:  Larapinta, QLD   Employment Type:  Full Time   Salary:  $130,000 to $150,000 per year, Plus Super and Company Vehicle 
 If you've spent years delivering results on sites for other people, you already know the reality: great outcomes only happen when someone sets the standard and holds it. 
 This is your opportunity to own an entire installation division, build a high-performing team, establish the systems others rely on, and run residential framing operations as if they were your own. 
  The Opportunity  
 Reporting directly to the General Manager, you will take full ownership of residential framing installation operations across South East Queensland. 
 You will be accountable for safety, quality, delivery and commercial performance across every active site while leading and developing a multi-disciplinary team that includes: 
 
 Site Supervisors 
 Service and Install Coordinator 
 Maintenance Carpenters 
 Subcontract Framing Crews 
 
 This is a senior operational leadership role, not a tools-on position. Based at the Larapinta facility, you will attend sites as required to verify quality, resolve issues and strengthen builder relationships. The majority of your role is proactive, focused on planning, coordination, performance management and continuous improvement. 
 You will work closely with Production, Design and Sales to ensure a seamless supply chain from detailing through to handover. 
  What Success Looks Like  
 In your first 90 days, you will: 
 
 Review all active sites to identify risks and improvement opportunities 
 Establish a structured weekly operating rhythm with supervisors and the install coordinator 
 Implement clear systems for tracking and resolving site issues 
 Reduce escalations to the General Manager by taking full operational ownership 
 
 Ongoing success will be measured by: 
 
 DIFOT at or above 95% 
 Reduced repeat defects and rectification costs 
 Supervisors confidently solving day-to-day issues independently 
 Consistent performance from reliable subcontractor crews 
 Builders recognising the business as their preferred framing partner 
 
  About You  
 You are a proven construction leader with strong hands-on residential framing knowledge. You understand load paths, bracing, tie-down requirements, sequencing and what it takes to get framing right the first time. 
 Whether you have progressed from the tools, site supervision or construction management, what matters most is your ability to lead people and deliver consistent operational outcomes. 
 You bring: 
 
 Strong technical knowledge in residential framing 
 Experience in residential construction, framing or site management 
 Confidence to uphold standards, even in difficult conversations 
 Commercial awareness and disciplined cost control 
 Clear, professional communication at all levels 
 Ability to attract, develop and retain quality subcontractor crews 
 A structured, systems-driven approach to operations 
 
 Steel framing experience is highly advantageous, but not essential. 
  This Role Is Not for Everyone  
 Please do not apply if you: 
 
 Avoid difficult or performance-based conversations 
 Prefer being on the tools rather than leading teams 
 Operate reactively and rely on constant firefighting 
 View subcontractors as disposable rather than long-term partners 
 
  Why Join This Business and What's On Offer?  
 
 True accountability with full ownership of safety, quality, delivery and cost across the division 
 Growth ahead with significant investment and a strong expansion pipeline 
 Direct reporting line to the General Manager 
 Values-driven culture focused on accountability, commitment, service, collaboration, quality and trust 
 Purpose-built Larapinta facility designed for high performance 
 Competitive salary package of $130,000 to $150,000 PLUS superannuation 
 Company vehicle provided 
 Career growth opportunities as the division continues to expand 
 
  How to Apply  
 If you are ready to make a real impact and help drive the success of our client's operations, we would love to hear from you. 
 Email your resume to  applications@recruitment247.com.au , or click  Apply  via this website. 
 For more information, contact Recruitment 24/7 on  (07) 3281 2489  Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 4:30pm.  Please  click here  to apply.

About the role

The Workforce Planning & Optimisation Manager is responsible for strengthening workforce planning, onboarding and service flow to improve the scalability, efficiency and sustainability of Home Care services.

Working closely with the Care Operations Manager and Workforce Scheduling Manager, the role provides demand and capacity insight, identifies improvement opportunities and supports the development of more effective workforce and service models.

The role focuses on planning, analysis and continuous improvement, and does not own day-to-day care delivery or current roster execution.

Essence of the role:

Demand & Capacity Planning: Develop demand forecasts and workforce capacity models to support forward planning and identify risks.

Workforce Modelling & Optimisation: Analyse workforce utilisation, scheduling patterns and service performance to improve efficiency and scalability.

Onboarding & Service Flow Improvement: Improve the flow from intake to service

commencement to reduce delays and service gaps.

Performance Insight & Reporting: Provide clear insights to support operational decision-making and performance improvement.

Systems & Process Improvement: Identify and implement improvements to systems, data use and operational processes

About You

Commitment to engage and align with Hammond Care's Christian Mission, Motivation and Mission in Action.

Significant experience in workforce planning, operations or service delivery.

Strong analytical capability and ability to translate insight into action.

Experience driving operational improvement and influencing stakeholders.

Sound understanding of workforce utilisation and service delivery environments.

Exposure to workforce management and scheduling technologies.

Tertiary qualifications in health, business, operations, or a related discipline.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills with key stakeholders

Knowledge of aged care compliance and administrative processes (desirable).

Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
